title: MCPiler Manifest catalogue entry metadata
description: Discovery and governance metadata for one catalogue entry. This is NOT an Engine runtime input: MCPiler Engine never reads catalogue.json. The ordinary Manifest is the runtime artifact.

id.description: Stable entry id; must match the containing directory name under entries/.

trust.description: Trust state. Automation MUST NOT promote an entry to mcpiler-reviewed; that requires an explicit MCPiler maintainer review recorded in 'review'.

path.description: Path to the ordinary Manifest relative to the entry directory.

formatVersion.description: MCPiler Manifest format version this entry targets (for example 0.3).

parameterized.description: When true the Manifest is a bounded template that must be materialized before use; materializeInputs MUST then be non-empty.

reviewedRevision.description: Immutable upstream revision (tag, commit or release) the review was performed against.

secrets.description: User-supplied secret references declared by the Manifest. Names only; never values.

name.description: Environment variable name a fromEnv reference reads (or a stable label for a fromFile reference).

materializeInputs.description: Bounded, non-secret inputs the materializer may apply. The only supported kind is an absolute instance URL.

target.description: The only Manifest members the materializer may rewrite.

upstreamDocsIncluded.description: Whether any upstream specification/documentation text is included verbatim. Must be false unless a compatible treatment is recorded.

inspected.description: Whether Engine inspect was run against the materialized Manifest during review.
